Home.subtitle: Recomendações de plantas companheiras para seus canteiros.
Home.addAtLeast2: Adicione pelo menos 2 plantas à sua lista de desejos.

explore.heading: Find who your plants love.
explore.description: Search any plant to discover its best companions — and the ones to keep apart. Backed by traditional knowledge and community observations.

plan.heading: Know what fits together.
plan.description: Map out your beds with plants that support each other. Catch conflicts before they happen and make the most of every square metre.

evaluate.heading: See how your beds get along.
evaluate.description: Check the health of your existing garden layout. Get suggestions to improve harmony, yield, and soil over time.

community.heading: Be part of the science.
community.description: Collaborate with researchers and curious growers worldwide. Share your own garden observations, add useful sources you discover, or help fund the collection of peer-reviewed research through advanced scientific research AI. Every contribution strengthens our shared understanding of companion planting.
